notes: Modified cash basis audit, FY ended 9/30/2023. Governmental lines from the governmental funds Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balances Totals 2023 column (p6). Taxes 298,849 split by Schedule 2 totals (p11: property 145,209, motor vehicle 11,161, sales 142,479; non-major funds have no taxes); Intergovernmental 98,528 split by Schedule 2 totals (p11). Charges for services 83,412 split into General Fund garbage collection 77,917 (Schedule 2 p10) and non-major charges 5,495. Bond principal and interest printed under Other financing sources (uses) recorded as other_financing. Business-type statement lines from the government-wide Statement of Activities (p2; Water expenses 95,975 include interest expense 940); business_type is net position (modified cash), ties 924,887 + 136,796 - 143,829 + 85,454 = 1,003,308. Proprietary cash flows from Exhibit I (p9). Balance sheet: government-wide Statement of Net Position (p1) because it includes capital assets and debt; zero line 'Restricted for public works' omitted. Detail: Schedule 2 major funds (pp10-11), Schedule 4 non-major funds one line per fund column (pp12-13; Fire Fund all zero), proprietary Exhibit H per fund (p8). Schedule 5 (p14, receipts/disbursements by fund group vs budget) and Schedule 6 (p15, combined proprietary budgetary basis) not recorded to avoid double counting. Read pages 1-15 of 15
